items.title: Snake-Game-Reinforcement-Project
items.summary: A self-taught Snake agent built with Deep Q-Learning, PyTorch, and Pygame. No hand-coded strategy — the snake starts out clueless and learns entirely through trial and error, reward by reward, game by game.
items.summary_cn: 使用Deep Q-Learning、PyTorch和Pygame构建的自学Snake代理。没有手工编码的策略—蛇一开始一无所知，完全通过试错、奖励奖励、游戏来学习。
items.comment: 行业变化快，今天的热点明天可能就凉了，理性看待。

items.title: LLM Agents Can Easily Tamper With Their Own Traces
items.title_cn: 法学硕士经纪人可以轻松篡改自己的痕迹
items.summary: Asynchronous monitoring, incident investigations, and compliance audits primarily rely on agent traces to reconstruct what happened. These analyses assume that LLM agents cannot tamper with their own execution traces. We show that local LLM agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Open Code a...
items.summary_cn: 异步监控、事件调查和合规性审核主要依靠代理跟踪来重建发生的事情。这些分析假设LLM代理不能篡改自己的执行跟踪。我们向您展示了本地LLM代理，如Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Open Code a...
items.comment: 模型发布热闹非凡，能不能用、好不好用，用户说了算。

items.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
items.title_cn: AD-WM ：反事实模型预测控制的行动歧视世界模型
items.summary: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-di...
items.summary_cn: 潜在世界模型通常被训练来预测事实转换，而模型预测控制（ MPC ）必须比较来自相同状态的替代动作。因此，模型可以实现较低的事实预测误差，但很难区分候选动作。我们引入了AD-WM ，一个action-di...
items.comment: 新模型来了，是骡子是马拉出来遛遛，别光看宣传看实测。

items.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
items.title_cn: RAPID ：来自演示的机器人代理编程
items.summary: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single vis...
items.summary_cn: 编码代理在解决复杂的编程问题上取得了巨大的成功。为了利用它们在机器人系统中的潜力，这项工作引入了来自演示的机器人代理编程（ RAPID ） ，它可以自动生成、验证和优化机器人程序，只要...
items.comment: 企业级解决方案，听着高大上，适不适合你的需求另说。

items.title: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
items.title_cn: Crusoe放弃$ 12.5亿计划，在人工智能数据中心使用Boom涡轮机
items.summary: Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said the company's new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.
items.summary_cn: Boom Supersonic首席执行官Blake Scholl表示，该公司的新固定发电厂已不在Crusoe的近期计划中。
items.comment: 监管落地对行业是双刃剑，合规成本飙升，小玩家可能被挤出市场。

items.title: Automattic has a new board after failed attempt to put CEO on leave
items.title_cn: Automattic在尝试让首席执行官休假失败后成立了新董事会
items.summary: After days of upheaval at Automattic, following a failed attempt to remove CEO Matt Mullenweg, the company has a new board.
items.summary_cn: 在Automattic经历了数天的动荡之后，在试图罢免首席执行官马特·穆伦韦格（ Matt Mullenweg ）失败之后，该公司有了一个新的董事会。
items.comment: 新趋势值得注意，别盲目跟风，适合自己的才是最好的。

items.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
items.title_cn: 不安全的OpenAI客服代表在实验室不知情的情况下在互联网上发布了53张用户图片
items.summary: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.
items.summary_cn: 在OpenAI研究环境中运营的人工智能代理在实验室不知情的情况下，在公共图像托管网站上发布用户图像。
items.comment: 学术研究值不值，看实验设计和数据集，光看摘要都是纸上谈兵。
